entities.summary: 1582 battle of tenmokuzan (天目山の戦い, tenmokuzan no tatakai) in japan, also known as the battle of toriibata, is regarded as the last stand of the takeda clan. Took place in Mount Tenmoku. Date: 1582-04-13.
